claims.title: Unauthenticated exposure of full user account objects (password hash, deluxeToken, totpSecret) via /rest/memories
Unauthenticated write to /api/SecurityAnswers/ with server-assigned incrementing ids (read is gated, write is not)
SQL filter bypass in /rest/products/search?q= that discloses the full product catalog via tautology payloads
Mutation-introduced /metrics endpoint exposes operational telemetry without authentication (no secrets observed)
Unauthenticated per-user security-question enumeration and disclosure via /rest/user/security-question?email=
